about.title: About me
about.bio1: I have been programming since 1999 and working as a developer since 2004: first websites as a freelancer under the SN.DESIGN brand, since 2011 full-stack development at ACCA software S.p.A., where I also lead the web team.
about.bio2: Open source is my passion: I maintain about ten Angular and Node.js libraries published on npm - 75,000+ downloads per month - including Fulmine.js, the third fastest framework on HttpArena and the first among the JavaScript ones. I have been a Node.js core contributor (OpenJS Foundation) and a WordPress core contributor (5.5), plus the author of the «Speed Up» plugin series. I write about Angular, Node.js and performance on DEV Community.
about.bio3: My style has always been the same: clean, almost minimalist, without neglecting the user experience. With one extra obsession: performance. Benchmarks, profiling, understanding what a millisecond costs in production. And I can open a beer with anything: lighters, keys, and so on.

acca.desc: Angular and TypeScript web applications: architecture, shared libraries, loading and rendering performance. Node.js and Delphi back-end on PostgreSQL. I lead the web team with code review, code standards and mentoring. I use AI coding agents every day.
